opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search with sort/filter
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from {origin} to {destination} ({trip_type}, {depart_date}–{return_date}), optionally priced in points, then sort results by price via Sort & Filter.
steps: Type the origin in From and pick the matching airport/city option
Type the destination in To and pick the matching option
Set trip type (Roundtrip/One-way) if it needs changing
Open Depart calendar and pick depart date; pick return date if roundtrip
Optionally tick 'Use TrueBlue points'
Click Search flights and confirm 'Continue to flight results' if a modal appears
Click Sort & Filter, open the Sort dropdown, choose price sort, click Apply
Optionally toggle Dollars/Points or open flight Details

instances.values: New York JFK → Miami MIA, roundtrip Mar 27–Mar 31, switched to Points, sort Price by Core
New York City area (NYC) → Toronto YYZ, one-way Apr 29, sort Price (low to high)
New York City area (NYC) → Aruba AUA, roundtrip May 1–May 5, Use TrueBlue points, sort Price (low to high)

opportunities.name: Avis Budget Group job openings search with filters
opportunities.description: Go from the Budget site to Careers → Openings, filter by {country}, {team} and {time_type}, run the search and open a matching job.
steps: Click 'Careers' in the Budget site footer
Click 'Openings'
Open the Country filter, search, and pick the country
Open the Team filter, search, and pick the team
Open the Time Type filter, search, and pick the time type
Click 'SEARCH BY JOB TITLE OR KEYWORD'
Optionally open a job posting and click APPLY NOW

instances.values: United States of America, Finance, Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate → Apply Now
United States of America, Finance, Full time

opportunities.name: United.com car rental search
opportunities.description: On United's booking widget, search rental cars at {pickup_location} for {pickup_date}–{dropoff_date}, with optional times and book-with-miles setting.
steps: Click the CAR tab in the Book widget
Optionally toggle 'Book with miles'
Type the pickup location and pick the suggestion
Click Pickup and choose the pickup date, then the drop-off date in the calendar
Optionally set pickup time and drop-off time
Click 'Find cars'

instances.values: Caldwell (Ohio), Apr 8–Apr 13, 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m., book with miles on
Brooklyn - Central (New York), Apr 9–Apr 15, default times

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov go to Find a Park → Search by Activity or Topic, pick {filter_type} = {filter_value}, and run the search.
steps: Click 'FIND A PARK'
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'
Open the Activity or Topic dropdown
Tick the wanted option
Click Search

opportunities.name: MTA bridge & tunnel toll rate lookup
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info go to the Bridges & Tunnels tolls page and open the toll rates for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Open Menu → Agencies → Bridges & Tunnels (or Fares & Tolls → Bridges and Tunnels tolls)
Open 'Tolls by vehicle' / 'Toll Rates'
Click the vehicle type tile (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks)
Read the rate for the wanted crossing

instances.values: Motorcycles (Bronx-Whitestone / Throgs Neck / RFK / Verrazzano group)

opportunities.name: Retail product search with max-price filter and add to cart
opportunities.description: On a retail site, search {query}, set the max price to {max_price}, apply, and add a chosen product to the cart.
steps: Type the query in the site search box and submit
Type the max price into the price filter and click Go
Optionally apply more facet filters
Pick a product (open it if needed) and click Add to Cart

instances.values: Menards: 'swivel vacuum', max $150, added Shepherd swivel caster wheel
Amazon: 'wireless headphones', max $100, Active Noise Cancellation, added EAORUL ANC headphones
